Silver Bottle Cap is returning to Pokémon GO! 

You can use them to max out ONE stat of your Pokémon, which means your 98% Shiny could finally become a SHUNDO! 💯

🔍 Use this search string to find potential shundos in your storage!
4attack,4defense&4attack,4hp&4defense,4hp&!4*&!shadow&shiny

⚠️ Remember:
• Good Buddy or higher required
• Shadow Pokémon are not eligible
• Hyper Trained Pokémon can't be transferred to Pokémon HOME

Have you already picked your first Pokémon to Hyper Train? 👀

#PokemonGO
